note: Number Link (numbers 11-19, half-abstract: ten-frame picture <-> number card). English only. Teaching asks nothing, so nothing to self-answer; the 1s pause before the demo line is a dramatic beat. Type A = a1_q..a4_q (three numbers on the left, three pictures on the right, drag a line). Type B = b1_a..b3_a plus the shared link_right (three pictures on the left, three numbers on the right). Type C = c1_a..c3_a plus the shared how_many and touch_num (one picture, three number keys). Runtime shuffles the ten questions and each column.
